description: Percona ClusterSync for MongoDB (PCSM): sync lag, change replication, initial sync, HA roles and process health.

panels.description: Whether PMM can scrape each PCSM instance's /metrics endpoint (1 = UP, 0 = DOWN). An instance that has been unreachable for the whole selected time range is not listed in the Service Name variable and is not shown here. If the PCSM host or its pmm-agent is down, no scrape result exists and the stat shows "unknown"; use the Node Summary dashboard for host health.
panels.title: Exporter Up

panels.description: The PCSM instance that currently holds the HA lease (ACTIVE) and runs the sync. Requires PCSM 1.0.0 or later.
panels.title: Active Instance

panels.description: Lag between the source and target clusters, in logical seconds, reported by the ACTIVE instance. A value of 0 is also reported before replication has started.
panels.title: Replication Lag

panels.description: Remaining logical seconds until the initial sync catches up, reported by the ACTIVE instance. After the initial sync completes, PCSM keeps reporting the last value until the process restarts.
panels.title: Initial Sync Lag

panels.description: Replication lag and initial-sync lag of the ACTIVE instance, in logical seconds.
panels.title: Lag Time

panels.description: Change events read from the source and applied to the target per second by the ACTIVE instance. Read persistently above applied means a growing backlog.
panels.title: Change Events Rate

panels.description: Role of each PCSM instance over time: ACTIVE holds the lease and runs the sync, STANDBY waits to take over. Requires PCSM 1.0.0 or later.
panels.title: Instance Roles

panels.description: Current HA lease term per cluster (HA group). It increases every time a different instance takes over the lease.
panels.title: Lease Term

panels.description: HA role changes per instance in the selected time range. An instance that starts and becomes ACTIVE counts one transition (STANDBY to ACTIVE at startup).
panels.title: Role Transitions

panels.description: Events waiting in the reader-to-dispatcher queue of the ACTIVE instance.
panels.title: Dispatcher Queue

panels.description: Events waiting in the replication workers' inbound queues of the ACTIVE instance: total across workers, and the fullest single worker.
panels.title: Worker Event Queues

panels.description: Sealed bulk writes waiting in the workers' async queues of the ACTIVE instance: total, and the fullest single worker.
panels.title: Worker Bulk Queues

panels.description: Events applied per second by all replication workers of the ACTIVE instance.
panels.title: Worker Events Applied

panels.description: 99th percentile duration of bulk write flushes to the target, across all workers of the ACTIVE instance. Shows no data while the source has no writes, because there are no flushes to measure.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (service_name, le) (rate(percona_clustersync_mongodb_repl_worker_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"}) unless on(service_name) (percona_clustersync_mongodb_ha_active{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} == 0)))

panels.title: Flush Duration (p99)

panels.description: 99th percentile number of operations per bulk write flush, across all workers of the ACTIVE instance. Shows no data while the source has no writes, because there are no flushes to measure.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (service_name, le) (rate(percona_clustersync_mongodb_repl_worker_flush_batch_size_bucket{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"}) unless on(service_name) (percona_clustersync_mongodb_ha_active{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} == 0)))

panels.title: Flush Batch Size (p99)

panels.description: Top 10 workers by inbound queue size over the selected range (ACTIVE instance only).
panels.title: Worker Event Queue - $service_name

panels.description: Top 10 workers by events applied per second over the selected range (ACTIVE instance only).
panels.title: Worker Events Applied - $service_name

panels.description: Top 10 workers by p99 bulk write flush duration over the selected range (ACTIVE instance only). Workers that did not flush in the interval are not shown.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (worker, le) (rate(percona_clustersync_mongodb_repl_worker_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"}) unless on(service_name) (percona_clustersync_mongodb_ha_active{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} == 0))))

panels.title: Worker Flush Duration (p99) - $service_name

panels.description: Share of the estimated data size inserted into the target by the ACTIVE instance. Only meaningful during an uninterrupted clone: the estimate is set when a clone starts, and the counters reset when PCSM restarts or fails over.

targets.expr: max by (service_name) (percona_clustersync_mongodb_copy_insert_size_bytes_total{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} unless on(service_name) (percona_clustersync_mongodb_ha_active{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} == 0)) / max by (service_name) ((percona_clustersync_mongodb_estimated_total_size_bytes{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} unless on(service_name) (percona_clustersync_mongodb_ha_active{environment=~"$environment",cluster=~"$cluster",service_name=~"$service_name"} == 0)) > 0)

panels.title: Copy Progress

panels.description: Bytes inserted into the target during the initial clone, against the estimated total size to copy (ACTIVE instance). The copy counters belong to each PCSM process, so an instance that became ACTIVE after a restart or failover shows no clone data.
panels.title: Copied vs Estimated Size

panels.description: Bytes per second read from the source and inserted into the target during the initial clone (ACTIVE instance). The copy counters belong to each PCSM process, so an instance that became ACTIVE after a restart or failover shows no clone data.
panels.title: Copy Throughput

panels.description: Documents per second read from the source and inserted into the target during the initial clone (ACTIVE instance). The copy counters belong to each PCSM process, so an instance that became ACTIVE after a restart or failover shows no clone data.
panels.title: Documents Copied per Second

panels.description: Duration of the most recent read and insert batch during the initial clone (ACTIVE instance).
panels.title: Batch Duration

panels.description: CPU used by each PCSM process (100% = one full core).
panels.title: CPU Usage

panels.description: Resident memory (RSS) of each PCSM process.
panels.title: Resident Memory

panels.description: Open and maximum file descriptors of each PCSM process.
panels.title: File Descriptors

panels.description: Go runtime goroutines and OS threads of each PCSM process.
panels.title: Goroutines and Threads

panels.description: Go heap memory of each PCSM process.
panels.title: Go Heap

panels.description: Median and maximum Go garbage-collection pause of each PCSM process.
panels.title: GC Pause Duration

title: MongoDB ClusterSync Details
